candidate_relations.reason: Ewing sarcoma is a related small-round-cell malignancy but the myogenic IHC (MyoD1, myogenin, desmin) supports rhabdomyosarcoma rather than Ewing.
Dermatofibroma is a benign fibrous histiocytoma, not a MyoD1-positive small-round-cell sarcoma.

case_quality_flags: Cutaneous small-round-blue-cell tumor positive for MyoD1/myogenin/desmin is embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma; neither candidate uses that name
